name: hcapp_setEventRsvp
description: Updates a hasher's RSVP (RsvpState 1 no, 2 maybe, 3 yes) and/or hare flag for an event, inserting the HasherEventMap row if there is none. A hasher already checked in (AttendenceState >= 20) keeps their RSVP — only a hare-flag change is applied, and the SP still answers success = 1 with an explanatory serverMessage. RSVP 1 (not coming) forces IsHare 0. With @autoSetNotifications = 1 the event's notification/email preferences are set at the same time: 2 (off) on a No, otherwise copied from the CALLER's HasherKennelMap row. HC.Event.Hares is kept in step when the hare flag changes (rebuilt only where the text is this SP's own; admin-typed text only ever gains a name). Run counts are recalculated for the hasher after every call, the final row state is returned as adHocData, and the SP delegates to HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData. Auth: device-bound token via HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 26, @param NULL). Permission gate: NONE — @hasherId defaults to the caller but may name any hasher (see code smells).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID, passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth. No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token validated against the device secret. No SQL default.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The event (Event.id). Must equal the row's EventId when @hemId is given (1226/12). No SQL default.

parameters.name: hasherId
parameters.description: Target hasher; NULL = the caller. Replaced by the row's UserId when @hemId is given. No SQL default — the client must send it (NULL is fine).

parameters.name: isHare
parameters.description: Default -1 = keep (normalised to NULL). 1 set, 0 clear; forced to 0 when @rsvpState = 1. On INSERT any value > 0 becomes 1.

parameters.name: rsvpState
parameters.description: Default -1 = keep (normalised to NULL). 1 not coming, 2 maybe, 3 coming. Not range-checked; on INSERT a NULL is written straight to the NOT NULL column (see code smells).

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark passed to hcapp_syncEventAdminData; NULL is coerced to 'ignore'. No SQL default — omitting it is an unlogged 500.

parameters.name: hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark passed to hcapp_syncEventAdminData; NULL is coerced to 'ignore'. No SQL default — omitting it is an unlogged 500.

parameters.name: hemId
parameters.description: Default NULL. When given, the row is addressed directly (visitor/virgin rows) and @hasherId is taken from it; its EventId must equal @eventId (1226/12). An id with no row is not detected — the mismatch test is UNKNOWN and the SP carries on.

parameters.name: autoSetNotifications
parameters.description: Default 1: a No sets EventNotificationPreference and EventEmailAlertPreference to 2; any other RSVP copies the caller's HasherKennelMap.Kennel*Preference for the kennel (the UPDATE writes both, the INSERT only the notification preference). 0 leaves the preferences alone.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Always the first rowset, on every path including auth failure.

columns.name: success
columns.description: 1 on success (including the 'already checked in' and 'nothing changed' outcomes), 0 on any error.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: NULL on success. ValidateAppAuth code; 1226 hemId/eventId mismatch; 1926 unhandled.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: NULL on success. 1 bad token / 3 device not found / 7 signed out (ValidateAppAuth); 12 validation; 19 unhandled (CATCH).

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Rowset 1 on failure only. Every path writes HC.ErrorLog.

rowsets.name: AdHocRsvpResult
rowsets.description: Rowset 1 on success (lines 325-334), including the two no-change outcomes. Row values are re-read by EventId + UserId after the write.

columns.name: serverMessage
columns.description: '' on a write. '<name> is already checked in at the Hash. The RSVP can no longer be changed.~~To change the RSVP, you must first mark <name> as being not at the Hash.' when attended and the RSVP differs; 'The RSVP status has not changed for <name>' when nothing changed. '~~' separates sentences.

columns.name: hasherEventMapId
columns.description: HasherEventMap.id (new or existing). Not lowercased — the app's lowerGuidsInPlace handles it.

columns.name: hares
columns.description: The rebuilt Event.Hares text — only when the hare flag changed AND the text was this SP's own to rebuild. NULL when the flag did not change and NULL when a name was appended to admin-typed text (the client must not treat NULL as 'no hares').

rowsets.name: SyncEventAdminData
rowsets.description: Rowsets 2+ on success: HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData for @eventId with the HEM/HKM watermarks passed through and hashers, narrow events, payments, kennel credits and receipts 'ignore'. See that contract.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap SET RsvpState, IsHare, EventNotificationPreference, EventEmailAlertPreference (each COALESCEd), updatedAt WHERE id = @hemId — when the RSVP or hare flag changes before attendance, or only the hare flag changes after it (lines 207-231).
INSERT HC.HasherEventMap (RsvpState = @rsvpState, IsHare, VirginVisitorType 0, EventNotificationPreference, KennelId from HC.Event) when the hasher has no row on the event (lines 232-247).

UPDATE HC.Event SET Hares, updatedAt when the hare flag changed (lines 265-291): rebuilt from flagged hares (IsHare = 1 AND RsvpState = 3) only when the current text is empty or equals that aggregate as it stood before the change; admin-typed text is never replaced and gains a newly flagged hare's DisplayName if absent (1.1.0, 2026-09-28 — before, a flagged hare RSVPing No replaced typed co-hares wholesale).
EXEC HC6.nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser @userId = @hasherId after COMMIT, outside the TRY, on every successful call (line 311).
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on the hemId/eventId mismatch (line 102) and in the CATCH (line 300); HcVersion from HC6.DeviceHcVersion(@deviceId).
EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData after the adHocData rowset (line 342).

codeSmells.detail: Line 117 defaults @hasherId to the caller but any hasher UUID (or any @hemId) is accepted and nothing compares it with @userId or calls HC6.CheckKennelPermission. Any authenticated device can RSVP, un-RSVP or flag as hare any hasher on any run. Its sibling hcapp_setEventAttendence gates the same action with 'manageAttendance' (its lines 225-250).

Lines 3-6, 9-10: @deviceId, @accessToken, @eventId, @hasherId and both sync watermarks have no SQL default. @hasherId is documented as 'defaults to caller if NULL' yet a client that leaves it out gets 'expects parameter @hasherId, which was not supplied' before the procedure runs — an empty 500 with no HC.ErrorLog row.

codeSmells.issue: Auto-set preferences come from the caller, not the target
codeSmells.detail: Lines 179-183 read HasherKennelMap for @userId (the caller). When an admin RSVPs on behalf of another hasher, that hasher's event preferences are set from the ADMIN's kennel preferences; when the admin has no row at the kennel they are set to NULL.

codeSmells.issue: INSERT with no RSVP writes NULL into a NOT NULL column
codeSmells.detail: Line 242: a first call for a hasher with @rsvpState -1/NULL (e.g. flag as hare only) inserts RsvpState = NULL. HasherEventMap.RsvpState is NOT NULL, so the insert fails and is reported as 1926/19 'Unexpected error' rather than a validation error. @rsvpState is otherwise unchecked (any INT is accepted, narrowed to SMALLINT).

codeSmells.issue: Re-reads by EventId + UserId are ambiguous for visitor rows
codeSmells.detail: Lines 262-263 and 316-321 look the row up by EventId + UserId although the write was by @hemId. Visitor/virgin rows share the KennelId as UserId, so with several such rows on one event the hare-change test and the values echoed in rowset 1 may come from a different row than the one written.

codeSmells.issue: Run counts recalculated on every call, outside the transaction
codeSmells.detail: Line 311 runs nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser unconditionally after COMMIT, even when nothing changed. A failure there surfaces as a raw error after the commit, with the envelope not yet sent.

codeSmells.issue: serverMessage uses '~~' as a sentence separator
codeSmells.detail: Lines 250-253: a display protocol the client must know to split on. Undocumented in the SP.

breakingChanges: HC5 bug fixed: the condition allowing hare-flag-only changes while attended used '@rsvpState = -1' after the sentinel had already been normalised to NULL, making the branch always false. HC6 correctly uses '@rsvpState IS NULL'.
TRY/CATCH and transaction added — HC5 had neither; unhandled errors now roll back and return a structured error rowset.
Success envelope rowset (rowset 0: success, errorCode, errorType) added — HC5 had no envelope.
HC5 error path returned a single StandardErrors rowset; HC6 returns two rowsets on error: SuccessEnvelope (rowset 0) then ErrorDetail (rowset 1).
Delegation target updated from HC5.hcapp_syncEventAdminData to HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData.
nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser now called after transaction commit rather than inline (HC5 had no transaction).
